_comment: Example ROI config for a single intersection with 4 approaches. Coordinates are pixel [x, y] in the camera frame, polygon points listed in order (clockwise or counter-clockwise) tracing the approach lane(s). 'queue_zone' is a smaller polygon near the stop line used for queue-length estimation; omit it (or set to null) if not calibrated. These placeholder coordinates assume a 1280x720 frame and MUST be recalibrated for real footage -- use scripts/calibrate_rois.py.
